requirements.text: The successMessage variable must be defined within the Knockout.js binding context to prevent ReferenceErrors during visibility checks.
The RegisterViewModel must be properly defined and initialized before the script execution on the Register page.
The system must successfully process the form submission button click on the registration page without console errors.
